One question about an acorn shows how big success thinking can get.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a night at a bar in Denver, where he met the past president of Tandy Corporation. Asked for the secret of his success, the man said one word: vision. He held up a pack of matches and asked Kevin to imagine it was an acorn.

Kevin said he saw a tree. The man said he saw a forest. The difference, he explained, was the size of the vision and the time it takes.

What would you see in the acorn?
